name: Noel
source:
[i]"Won't you be my friend, Miss Sylphid?"[/i]

A young boy with a cybertech eye and a shrewd personality. He's quite attached to the heroine and Mia, but everything else about him—where he lives, what his goals are—is shrouded in mystery.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=noel]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
